why: No row is required, and the record therefore names no driver, no instance and no verdict path: scripts/overlay-verdict-claims.test.mjs refuses a list with no required row that names a driver, so naming one would be the opposite defect.

The reason is not convenience. A required row must name the driver a control-ai-browsers run expression takes to the wave gate, and that driver must return the gate's four readings - toolElements, drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext. Every fact the 4 criteria this milestone declares is written about is a fact about this repository's own guard record, the join that reads it and the tests that hold them, against 12 stage(s) of the check chain; none of them is an element's rect or a dev context, so naming a driver would make the gate return a page reading for a claim about the gate.
The portal is not lost by that ruling: each reason names the clause that would have made a row required, and each claim names the suite, the test and the commands that prove it.

capture.reading: an armed run re-derives the list from the intent this checkout binds, its five-column edge coverage, the suites the plan assigns each edge and the tests this checkout declares, and writes it only when a value moved; a default run reads the file and asserts it is exactly what this head derives, naming the field that moved when it is not.

claims.criterionText: A cancelled navigation whose guard ran a side effect produces a finding naming the guard, the phase it ran in and the verdict that cancelled; a mutant that cancels before the guard runs reddens it, and the red names the phase field.
claims.reason: The charter's portal clause makes a verdict required where an insurance-portal route can produce a criterion's facts. SC1 is "A cancelled navigation whose guard ran a side effect produces a finding naming the guard, the phase it ran in and the verdict that cancelled; a mutant that cancels before the guard runs reddens it, and the red names the phase field." - a fact about this repository's own record, its joins and the tests that hold them, which no route of any page produces: it is proved by the suite and test this claim names, at this head, and the gate's one `control-ai-browsers run` driver returns an element's toolElements, drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext readings, none of which can say what a test reddens, so a portal-backed row would name a driver that cannot carry the answer. The portal is named because the clause is answered rather than dodged: the evidence is the edge row(s) ["E1","E2","E7"] the intent itself assigns the criterion, held by the plan at ["scripts/guard-answer.test.mjs","scripts/panel-routes.test.mjs"], and the 4 citation(s) below name the tests that carry them. The plan's two tables disagree about E7, held out at T003 while the coverage table assigns SC1 to T001/T002/T004/T005/T006/T007, which this record states under evidence.plan.disagreements rather than refusing to cite it.
